parsed.title: AI tools and job market discussion

topics.title: Automation of job search with AI

claims.text: Full automation with PDF resume generation per vacancy is advantageous because recruiters can analyze the resume during technical interviews.
Planning to set up OpenClaw for vacancy search, resume and cover letter generation after startup closure.
Modern AI skills (Cursor, Claude Code, LLM, RAG, Embeddings) are now essential for developers to avoid being filtered out by recruiters.
Expectation that the recruiter profession will eventually disappear.
Using GPT to generate join queries drastically speeds up development, handling routine code and highlighting missing details.
AI-generated code can produce overly large or inefficient queries, leading to performance and security issues in production.
Incremental computations have been replaced by view-based solutions.

topics.title: Limitations and risks of AI-generated code

claims.text: AI-generated code can contain massive raw SQL (e.g., 450 lines) that pulls excessive data and harms performance.
Engineers sometimes push unreviewed SELECT * queries to production despite community best practices.
AI tools do not understand the nuanced context that a developer accumulates over time.
In 2024, AI was viewed skeptically; by 2026 it is seen as mainstream and necessary.
The market perception that AI accelerates development has been true since 2025, though tools are expensive.
